settings.dateFormat: not set: GnuCash's default, locale, which under C is %m/%d/%y; no checked cell shows a date

book: create-stock-test-data (5.17:bindings/guile/test/test-engine-extras.scm:952-1059), which both test groups build afresh (:52, :84); one book serves both. AAPL, MSFT and TSLA are NASDAQ commodities with SCU 1; only AAPL trades. The 1981-03-01 sale of 1/2 share is stored as -1 (SCU 1, rounded half up), so AAPL holds 42 shares from then on. Prices of AAPL in USD: 100 (1980-02-01), 200 (1980-03-01), 400 (1980-05-01), 50 (1981-01-01) and 6 (1981-03-01) from the transactions (source user:xfer-dialog, type test), and 40, 4 and 12 from the stock splits of 1980-10-01, 1980-11-01 and 1980-12-01 (source user:stock-split, type unknown), all at midnight UTC.
dates: No date in the book depends on now. Both templates' Date option defaults to the end of the accounting period (5.17:gnucash/report/options-utilities.scm:48-51), which with no preferences is the end of today: for the pinned now, 2024-03-15 23:59:59 UTC. The runs that keep the default (portfolio-latest and the three advanced runs) give the same figures for any now after 1981-04-01. pricedb-latest looks up prices at now; Advanced Portfolio's default pricedb-nearest at local noon of the Date (2024-03-15 12:00:00 UTC); both find the $6.00 of 1981-03-01.
optionValues: Options are those changed from the template's defaults and in effect for the run: the portfolio runs change one options object step by step (:53-78), the advanced runs another (:85-107). {"absolute": day} is gnc-dmy2time64 of that day, local (here UTC) midnight.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109): table 1, row 1 (the first data row, AAPL's), every <td> cell, giving every text node in document order. Whitespace is trimmed when parsing (:84), so Advanced Portfolio's marker cell, " " when the price comes from the price list, gives no text. Columns, Investment Portfolio (5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/portfolio.scm:242-249): Account, Symbol, Listing, Units, Price, Value. Advanced Portfolio with defaults (standard/advanced-portfolio.scm:852-1173): Account, Symbol, Listing, Shares, Price, marker, Basis, Value, Money In, Money Out, Realized Gain, Unrealized Gain, Total Gain, Rate of Gain, Income, Brokerage Fees, Total Return, Rate of Return.
